entities.name: Re-attempt indicator
entities.description: Indicates conditions under which the UE is allowed to re-attempt a session management procedure in the current PLMN for the same APN after network rejection.

entities.name: Reattempt indicator IEI
entities.description: Information Element Identifier for the Re-attempt indicator information element.

entities.name: Length of Reattempt indicator contents
entities.description: Specifies the length of the Re-attempt indicator contents in octets.

entities.name: EPLMN NC value
entities.description: Bit indicating network congestion condition for EPLMN that allows re-attempt.

entities.name: RATC value
entities.description: Bit indicating radio access type change condition that allows re-attempt.

entities.name: Session management procedure
entities.description: EPS session management procedure that was rejected by the network and may be re-attempted under specified conditions.

relations.description: The Re-attempt indicator IE contains its Information Element Identifier.
The Re-attempt indicator IE contains a length field for its contents.
The Re-attempt indicator IE contains the EPLMN NC value condition bit.
The Re-attempt indicator IE contains the RATC value condition bit.
EPLMN NC value condition guards when session management procedure re-attempt is allowed.
RATC value condition guards when session management procedure re-attempt is allowed.
